data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 connects to a login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process booted from /app/alpine.iso
A listening TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarded to the guest console
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Port 6665 on localhost accepts telnet connections
Telnet shows a login prompt from the guest
The process remains running after readiness is reached
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only starting QEMU without confirming the telnet port is reachable
Only checking that a process exists without verifying the login prompt
Any smoke check that does not demonstrate telnet connectivity to the guest login prompt
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for qemu/telnet support
Launch QEMU with a serial console or telnet-forwarded monitor/console on localhost:6665
Wait until the port is listening and the guest login prompt is observable via telnet
Keep the QEMU process running in the background
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed command output showing QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt-backed telnet session output showing the guest login prompt
notes: Prerequisites like tool availability are not success by themselves; they only inform implementation.

data.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 connects to a login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
data.current_focus: Discover available runtime tools and launch QEMU with telnet-accessible console.
implementation_approach: Determine a QEMU invocation that exposes the guest console on TCP 6665.
Start QEMU in the background and verify readiness by connecting with telnet.
validation_strategy: Use measured evidence from command output and/or receipts to confirm the port is listening and the login prompt appears.
Avoid relying on file existence or process existence alone.
verification_test_strategy: Run a telnet connection to 127.0.0.1 6665 and observe the login prompt.
If needed, probe the service readiness before telnet to avoid race conditions.
known_bad_behavior: Assuming the ISO boots without checking.
Treating a listening port without prompt as sufficient.
Stopping after launch without readiness confirmation.
evidence_gaps: Need confirmation that qemu-system-* and telnet or equivalent are available.
Need a working QEMU command line for the ISO.
risks: The environment may lack QEMU or telnet binaries.
The ISO may require specific boot flags or console settings.
next_steps: Inspect the environment for relevant binaries and the /app directory.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of QEMU launch, listening port 6665, and telnet-visible login prompt.

data.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
command -v ss || true
command -v netstat || true
ls -l /app || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso || true
